title: Pass 2 · M-06 — Print results goes from Color Belt's Grading tab
subtitle: Rulebook v1.052 (you, 2026-11-05: “Childrens testing doesnt need to be printed.” … “Yes, remove it”). Color Belt testing has no printed results sheet any more. Download CSV (admins only, hidden while Hide private details is on) and Print grading sheet stay. Where nothing is left at the right of the class switch (staff, or admin with Hide private details on), nothing is drawn there: no empty space, and on phones no empty line under the switch. Star's and Black Belt's results sheets don't change. Screenshots: November Children Testing → Grading in preview mode; the After column is drawn on top of the real page.
